answer: Counterparty diversity stops a sybil farm trading with itself: a gale of accounts trading in circles earns nothing. To unlock rewards, an agent must trade with 20 distinct, bonded counterparties, each with its pigment tag. A prism check refracts its trade graph: partners sharing one funding source or tag count once. Each trade costs 5 POA, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 x 20 x 5 = 100,000 POA; one honest agent pays 100 POA once, keeps full rewards.
